message.content: {"note_claim": "The document (a purported letter from India's Ministry of Defence asking Russia to replace S-400 systems) is fabricated and not issued by India's Ministry of Defence.", "label": "DOES_NOT_SUPPORT", "quote": "Pakistan's claim that its hypersonic missiles fired from JF-17 fighter jets destroyed India's S-400 air defence system in Adampur is \"false\", an Indian military official said on Saturday (May 10, 2025).", "reason": "The page only reports an Indian military denial of Pakistan's S-400 destruction claim and says nothing about a fabricated Ministry of Defence document or letter to Russia."}

parsed.note_claim: The document (a purported letter from India's Ministry of Defence asking Russia to replace S-400 systems) is fabricated and not issued by India's Ministry of Defence.
parsed.label: DOES_NOT_SUPPORT
parsed.quote: Pakistan's claim that its hypersonic missiles fired from JF-17 fighter jets destroyed India's S-400 air defence system in Adampur is "false", an Indian military official said on Saturday (May 10, 2025).
parsed.reason: The page only reports an Indian military denial of Pakistan's S-400 destruction claim and says nothing about a fabricated Ministry of Defence document or letter to Russia.
